instruction: Candid documentary medium shot of a bright indoor study room. On the left, the woman with dark hair and glasses (R2) sits at a wooden table, gesturing with a pen and looking at her companion. On the right, the man with short curly blonde hair (R1) sits facing her, holding a pen and listening attentively. They sit opposite each other with papers, a laptop, and a glass of water on the desk. Soft natural light illuminates the scene from a window in the background, creating a neutral, focused atmosphere.
